thesis: GMAB is a strongly trending, profitable biotech pulling back to the 20-day SMA after a large gap-up, which offers a defined-risk entry. The long-term trend is intact (close above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) and the company generates real cash with low dilution risk. The technical card gives a 4.2 reward/risk to a target just under the 52-week high, and analysts' mean target sits well above the price. Against that, the regime is risk-off, the driver of the spike is unknown, insiders are selling and valuation is rich, so this is a moderate-conviction, buy-the-dip setup and not a chase. The pre-market quote is above the entry zone, so wait for a dip or a hold of 50.7.
